claims.statement: The slot correction mitigation was applied to the wrong feed and did not resolve the held orders
claims.limitation: The correct feed for slot extension is not yet identified; direct feed correction failed

claims.statement: The pickup slot timing issue persists because the correction targeted the wrong carrier feed or scheduling system
claims.limitation: Indicates complexity in the feed/scheduling architecture; multiple feeds or systems may be involved

claims.statement: Re-allocating the stuck EXC-0921 orders may route them to a different carrier or lane with shorter confirmation latency or longer slot windows
claims.limitation: Assumes re-allocation will produce a different outcome; if rule v18 again allocates them to the same east node, the issue recurs

next_action.rationale: The slot correction mitigation targeted the wrong feed and failed. Replaying the allocation for the 186 held orders is a reversible action that may route them to a different carrier lane or scheduling system with either shorter confirmation latency or longer slot validity windows. This avoids the complexity of diagnosing which feed is correct and allows the allocation logic to route orders optimally. If the issue recurs, the alternative is to revert rule v18 itself, but replay is the less disruptive reversible action.
